This treatment train is modeled based on EPA drinking water treatment 31 COMPARISON OF COMMERCIAL, STATE-OF-THE-ART, FOSSIL-BASED AMMONIA PRODUCTION technology models (2023). Outputs of EPA model runs, which optimize water treatment for eight default design flows, are averaged and recorded in the NETL unit process library (2025a; 2025b). Flows are normalized by the average flow rate of the water, though low- end sensitivity is represented when flows are normalized by the water treatment facility’s design flow rate. The boundary of water treatment includes energy use, treatment consumables, and key materials and excludes excavation and site preparation, instrumentation, system controls, building structures, and heating and cooling systems. • For each case, an inventory of consumable chemicals, solvents, sorbents, catalysts, and wastes was assembled from a simulated facility cost sheet. Replacement rates were calculated by adding the daily consumption rate to a pro-rated estimate of initial fill requirements.
